description: Independent test-only policy for the synthetic semantic-validation experiment in docs/04_DATA_CONTRACT_SPEC.md section 6.1. It does not govern Tenure or any other column in the Kaggle workbook, and it does not modify or replace contracts/approved_policy.json.

required_contract_unit_declaration.description: The incoming synthetic handoff contract must declare the unit for SyntheticTenureMonths at unit_assumptions.SyntheticTenureMonths. A missing declaration or any value other than "months" produces FAIL.

trusted_reference.hash_covers: exact file bytes of the reference CSV
trusted_reference.approval_note: This reference becomes formally approved only after Git review and commitment. Until then it is the proposed trusted reference for this experiment, not an approved production baseline.

blocking_condition.description: Block when both the mean and the median of SyntheticTenureMonths exceed the maximum permitted relative change of 0.50 against the trusted reference.
